description: FNPF 2D floating box of fnpf_2d_6dof_box driven by REEF3D::CORAL (Z 40 1, fluid_body): heave only through a CORAL prismatic joint with a PTO damper and stiff end stops; the FNPF loads and added mass go to CORAL, which returns the motion at the RK stages (predictor). REEF3D_FNPF_6DOF and REEF3D_CORAL compared.
covers: CORAL fluid_load, body_track, PTO end stops
